# NCLEX Study To-Do List

## **1. Preparation Basics**
- [ ] Apply for your nursing license through your state board
- [ ] Register with Pearson VUE and schedule your exam
- [ ] Get ATT (Authorization to Test) letter
- [ ] Choose a primary study resource (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan, etc.)

---

## **2. Content Review**
- [ ] Review all major body systems
- [ ] Study pharmacology (drug classes, side effects, nursing implications)
- [ ] Master lab values and normal ranges
- [ ] Review priority/delegation rules
- [ ] Study infection control and safety protocols
- [ ] Cover maternal/newborn essentials
- [ ] Review pediatric milestones and care
- [ ] Study psychiatric nursing concepts

---

## **3. Practice Questions**
- [ ] Complete 75-150 questions daily
- [ ] Review ALL rationales (correct AND incorrect answers)
- [ ] Track weak areas and revisit them
- [ ] Practice SATA (Select All That Apply) questions
- [ ] Do timed practice to build stamina
- [ ] Complete at least 1-2 full readiness assessments

---

## **4. Test-Taking Strategies**
- [ ] Learn Maslow's Hierarchy prioritization
- [ ] Master ABCs (Airway, Breathing, Circulation)
- [ ] Practice nursing process application (ADPIE)
- [ ] Study "assess before implement" rule
- [ ] Learn when to delegate and to whom

---

## **5. Week Before Exam**
- [ ] Light review only—no cramming
- [ ] Confirm test center location and time
- [ ] Prepare valid ID
- [ ] Get adequate sleep
- [ ] Plan meals and logistics for test day

---

## **6. Test Day**
- [ ] Arrive early
- [ ] Stay calm and trust your preparation
- [ ] Read each question carefully
- [ ] Take breaks if needed

---

**Good luck—you've got this!** 🎉
